open(p,'w').write('def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Copy the vertical color sequence across the horizontal 5-bar span.
    top = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if 5 in row)
    left = next(c for c, v in enumerate(grid[top]) if v == 5)
    right = max(c for c, v in enumerate(grid[top]) if v == 5)
    seq = [(r, grid[r][left]) for r in range(top + 1, len(grid)) if grid[r][left] not in (0, 5)]
    for r, v in seq:
        for c in range(left, right + 1): out[r][c] = v
    # Repeat the horizontal color pattern upward alongside a vertical 5-bar.
    col = next(c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if sum(row[c] == 5 for row in grid) > 1)
    seed_rows = [r for r in range(len(grid)) if any(grid[r][c] not in (0, 5) for c in range(col + 1, len(grid[0])))]
    if seed_rows:
        lo, hi = min(seed_rows), max(seed_rows)
        for r in range(0, hi + 1):
            src = lo + ((hi - r) % (hi - lo + 1))
            for c in range(col + 1, len(grid[0])):
                if grid[src][c] not in (0, 5): out[r][c] = grid[src][c]
    return out
